purpose: P4 multi-null battery per Houston directive 'explore all 3 interpretations fully'. Tests +3.64sigma canonical-mask signal under: (1) apodized mask vs binary mask edge effects (iii diagnostic), (2) multipole-spectrum coherence (band signal vs single l=1), (3) bootstrap-pixel-resample (spatial-correlation-preserving null), (4) p_eq quartile stratification (interpretation ii diagnostic via depth/quality proxy). Plus prior tests in v1.0.107 (binomial-shuffle 3.64sigma) and v1.0.108 sky-rotation (2.56sigma).

apodized_canonical_mask.interpretation: If sigma drops substantially from +3.64 (binary canonical) under apodization, the +3.64sigma is at least partially a binary-mask edge artifact (interpretation iii). If sigma persists, the result is not a sharp-edge MASTER artifact.

bootstrap_pixel_resample.interpretation: Bootstrap preserves spatial correlations of the data (each pixel's per-galaxy chirality is sampled WITH replacement). If sigma stays high under bootstrap, the signal is robust to per-galaxy sampling variance.

p_eq_quartiles.interpretation: Monotonic sigma increase with p_eq quality could indicate (i) real dipole more visible in HC tracers. Decreasing sigma with quality could indicate (ii) systematic concentrated in low-confidence galaxies. Flat could indicate (iii) NaMaster artifact independent of catalog composition.
